topic: contiguous per-core partition improves gated prefill; gate authenticity false positive fixed

gate_fix.problem: a contended window in which the candidate never launched turned into an authenticity FAIL
gate_fix.fix: when the candidate produced no measurement and no kernel of any kind was observed, authenticity is reported inconclusive and the run RETESTs; delegation evidence (static or a launched vendor operator) still FAILs
gate_fix.verification_in_production: the next contended run reported authenticity pass instead of fail on the same candidate

partition_result.change: per-core contiguous partitioning: base = (core*iters+step)*rows*d instead of the interleaved stride
partition_result.conclusion: contiguous partitioning is a real improvement under the gate. Prefill is still short of parity and needs roughly another 21%.
